accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: Account Id for the service request. In temporary testing mode, the planner may collect it directly from the tester.

contactId.title: Contact Id
contactId.description: Contact Id for the customer, when available. In temporary testing mode, the planner may collect it directly from the tester.

issueType.title: Issue Type
issueType.description: Short issue category such as billing, outage, appointment, or service issue.

description.title: Description
description.description: Customer issue description collected by the agent.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Customer-reported severity: low, medium, high, critical, or emergency.

language.title: Language
language.description: Customer conversation language, such as en or es.

serviceAddress.title: Service Address
serviceAddress.description: Customer-provided service address notes for the issue.
